rules.note: Room names are calculation inputs; output is consolidated.

rules.description: LED ceiling-mounted light fittings, 230V, 50Hz, suitable for residential installation, complete with LED lamp/module, driver, mounting, wiring connection and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Main Building rooms/areas)
rules.formula: Sum of CEILING(Room Area ÷ 100) for eligible rooms/areas
rules.basis: One fitting per 100 sqft band, rounded up.
rules.note: Calculated room by room then consolidated; preliminary allowance, not a lux calculation.

rules.description: Ceiling-mounted electric fans, suitable for 230V, 50Hz residential installation, complete with fan regulator/controller, ceiling mounting accessories, wiring connection and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Eligible Main Building areas)
rules.formula: Number of eligible Main Building rooms/areas × 1
rules.basis: Eligible Main Building areas = all Main Building rooms/areas except Kitchen, Master Bathroom and Bathroom.
rules.note: Quantity = number of eligible Main Building rooms/areas × 1.

rules.description: Air-conditioning power supply points for split-unit air-conditioning equipment, complete with appropriate isolator/switch, wiring connection, containment and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Designated air-conditioned areas)
rules.basis: Eligible areas = Master Bedroom, Bedroom, Living and Dining.
rules.note: Quantity = number of eligible areas × 1.

rules.note: Porch uses B only for this rule; do not substitute Main Building Area A unless the formula explicitly says A+B.
